aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times, fewer repeated questions. Founder — Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We create practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering: it helps them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier with tools built around how this kind of business really works.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie — a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area — I learned more about the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers see only the pickup times your kitchen can really make. The system takes into account each dish’s preparation time and how many portions you prepare at once.

comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up a weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work if the trading places change?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, via Apple Pay or Google Pay, or on the spot at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel the subscription any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and access remains until the end of the paid month.

comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or on the spot, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. One complements the other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to an order when you hand it to the customer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen for customers showing order numbers and whether they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place — hygiene documents, insurance, gas equipment check. We’ll remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to work with HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can’t choose it.

featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine dishes into combos and offer extras at checkout to raise the average bill.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for enquiries on Messenger and Instagram.

featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own accounts with the right level of access.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an order cut-off time for items that need to be prepared in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.

featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.

featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatic texts to customers when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it becomes inactive for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter the stock — it goes down with every order, then the item sells out automatically.

featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your work from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems are designed for a fixed address, stable internet and the same schedule every week. But you are somewhere new every week, at different times, and mobile signal there is weak or missing altogether. HatchGrab was built exactly for this.

landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
